concerns.text: FR-001 (deterministic verifier) and SC-002 (energy measurement) lack complete task coverage. T012 (verifier) is marked [X] but T008c (TDP constant generation) is marked [ ] (incomplete). Without T008c, the energy calculation in T027 cannot function, leaving FR-004/SC-002 unimplementable.

FR-006 (exclude failed instances) and SC-003 (planner validity) lack a complete implementation path. T019d (exclusion_logger) is marked [ ] (incomplete). No other task covers the writing of exclusion events to `data/processed/exclusions.json` as required by the schema in T000b-gen.

SC-001 (pre-registered statistical framework) is blocked. T028b (Execute Pre-Registration) is marked [X], but T028a (Implement logic) is marked [X] yet the output artifact `pre_registration.yaml` is flagged as missing in the analysis report. T035 (Final Review) explicitly lists this as a missing artifact, indicating the task chain failed to produce the required output.

SC-002 (computational overhead comparison) is unmeasurable. T040b (Generate Literature-based GPU Conversion Factor) and T040c (Implement logic) are marked [ ] (incomplete). The plan requires this factor to estimate GPU-hours for the baseline comparison, and no alternative task covers this requirement.

SC-005 (scalability analysis) is at risk. T036 (Validate dataset distribution) is marked [ ] (incomplete). The task description requires it to verify statistical representativeness before the main experiment, but it depends on T014e-exec which is also incomplete. The pipeline cannot proceed to scaling analysis without this gate.

Duplicate task ID detected. T035 appears twice: once in Phase 5 ('Final Review and Artifact Verification') and again in Phase 7 ('Final Review and Artifact Verification'). The second instance has a comment 'ATOMIC: requested' but the ID is identical, causing ambiguity in tracking and execution.

Stale or inconsistent task status. T007 is marked [X] but contains a comment 'FAILED: unspecified'. T008c is marked [ ] but T008a-exec is [X]. The dependency chain for TDP calibration is broken, leaving the energy measurement tasks (T027) without the required input data.
